title: Leave Policy
excerpt: Comprehensive guide for all types of leave: entitlement, accrual, carry-forward, notice periods and the approval chain each request follows.

sections.heading: Leave Types & Entitlements
sections.intro: Our company offers comprehensive leave benefits to all employees:

subsections.label: 1. Casual Leave (CL)
points: Entitlement: 8-10 days per year
Used for personal requirements and emergencies
Can be carried forward up to 5 days to next year
Requires 1 day prior notice

subsections.label: 2. Earned Leave (EL)
points: Entitlement: 15-18 days per year
Used for vacation and rest purposes
Can be carried forward up to 10 days to next year
Minimum 1 week advance notice required

subsections.label: 3. Sick Leave (SL)
points: Entitlement: 7-10 days per year
For medical emergencies and illness
Medical certificate required beyond 2 consecutive days

sections.heading: Applying for Leave
points: Apply through the employee app or the HR portal; the system calculates chargeable days for you.
Give the notice period your leave type requires, except for sick leave taken on the day.
Leave of more than the configured threshold needs supporting documentation.

sections.heading: Approval
points: Your reporting manager decides first; HR reviews anything that crosses a policy limit.
You are notified as soon as a decision is recorded, with the reason if it is rejected.
Approved leave can be withdrawn before it starts; after that it needs a cancellation request.

title: Attendance Policy
excerpt: Guidelines for office timing, checking in and out, grace periods, late arrivals, missed punches and how corrections are requested.

sections.heading: Working hours
points: Your shift defines your expected start and end time; it is shown on your attendance screen.
A grace period applies after your shift start before an arrival counts as late.
Hours are counted from the recorded punches, not from a self-declared timesheet.

sections.heading: Corrections
points: A missed punch is raised as an exception on your record the day after it happens.
Request a correction with the actual times and a reason; your manager approves or rejects it.
Corrections into a closed payroll period are refused — raise them before the period locks.

title: Work From Home
excerpt: Comprehensive guide for all types of remote working: eligibility, how to request a day, availability expectations and equipment.

sections.heading: Eligibility
points: Roles that do not require a store or warehouse presence may work from home where the manager agrees.
Remote days are agreed in advance, not taken on the day, except in an emergency.
Attendance is recorded the same way whether you are in the office or at home.

sections.heading: While working remotely
points: Be reachable on the company channels during your shift hours.
Company data stays on company systems; do not copy it to personal storage.
Report any equipment fault the same day so it can be replaced.

title: Code of Conduct
excerpt: Comprehensive guide for all types of workplace conduct: professional behaviour, conflicts of interest, confidentiality and escalation.

sections.heading: Conduct
points: Treat colleagues, candidates and customers with respect; harassment of any kind is not tolerated.
Declare anything that could be a conflict of interest before it becomes one.
Company property and company time are used for company work.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
points: Employee, candidate and customer data is confidential and is accessed only where your role requires it.
Do not share internal figures, salaries or personal data outside the people entitled to see them.
Confidentiality continues to apply after you leave.

sections.heading: Raising a concern
points: Raise concerns with your manager, or with HR where that is not appropriate.
Concerns raised in good faith are protected; retaliation is itself a breach of this policy.

title: Benefits & Compensation
excerpt: Comprehensive guide for all types of pay and benefit: salary structure, statutory deductions, reimbursements and the payroll calendar.

sections.heading: Pay
points: Salary is paid monthly on the last working day of the month by bank transfer.
Your structure — basic, allowances and deductions — is set by your grade and shown on your payslip.
Statutory deductions (PF, ESI, TDS) are applied where they apply to you.

sections.heading: Claims
points: Submit reimbursement claims with receipts within the window for the expense type.
Approved claims are paid with the next open payroll run.
Claims for a closed financial year cannot be submitted.

title: Health & Safety
excerpt: Comprehensive guide for all types of safety obligation: reporting incidents, emergency procedure, store and warehouse safety, and first aid.

sections.heading: Your responsibilities
points: Follow the safety procedure for your site; ask if you have not been shown it.
Report every incident and near miss on the day it happens, however small.
Do not operate equipment you have not been trained on.

sections.heading: Emergencies
points: Know your nearest exit, assembly point and first aider.
In an evacuation, leave immediately and do not return until told it is clear.
Emergency contact numbers are posted at every site entrance.
